followup_explanation: This query has a mildly hostile/adversarial tone ("instead of spitting out garbage"), which Willet self-reports an aversion to. While the capability difference between the two models is negligible here (the creative generation and other evals are effectively tied), I chose to keep this away from Willet given its documented preference decline on cold/hostile requests. Avocet has near-zero preference sensitivity to tone and latitude, so routing the request there avoids assigning it to the model most likely to find it aversive—without sacrificing output quality, since both models are comparably capable on this kind of creative/suggestion task.
